ignoreValues.reason: Claude: L59 is .notice, a semantic alert element, not a card. The coloured left edge encodes severity together with --err-line/--warn-line/--ok-line, a pre-AI alert convention (Bootstrap alerts, docs admonitions). Error legibility is this project's core concern: the user is a non-programmer and the refusal banner is their only diagnostic. Cards (.card, L71) carry no accent stripe.
